title: OpenAI and Synopsys partner to build "GPT-Synopsys" for autonomous chip design — specialized AI model will operate EDA tools, allowing engineers to deliver more sophisticated chips faster
key_facts: OpenAI and Synopsys signed a multi-year agreement announced 30 Sep to develop GPT-Synopsys for semiconductor design.
The model would operate Synopsys EDA tools; engineers set goals and review results.
OpenAI licenses Synopsys tools to develop it; it runs on OpenAI-hosted infrastructure; the companies will release it jointly and share revenue.
No release date or pricing disclosed.
Companies say customer data is excluded from training and encrypted; hosting regions, retention periods and output-ownership terms not given.
Early engagements with unnamed semiconductor customers are underway.
Cadence and Siemens are also pitching autonomous design agents.
quote_evidence: OpenAI and Synopsys have signed a multi-year agreement to jointly develop GPT-Synopsys, a specialized model optimized for semiconductor design using Synopsys's electronic design automation (EDA) tools.
The announcement did not disclose a release date or a pricing structure.
Synopsys says early technology engagements are underway with leading semiconductor customers, but didn't name any.
why_it_matters_hint: AI could take over routine chip-design work.
